coverage_summary.disclosure: Counts describe the query plan actually executed and the candidates it produced -- not the true size of the real-world market. No completeness percentage is claimed.
coverage_summary.market_completeness_warning: No completeness percentage is established or implied. Query saturation and cross-provider overlap describe the executed plan, not the true size of the real-world lodging market.
coverage_summary.pet_friendliness_warning: Discovery records are candidates only. Google/OSM identifying a hotel or motel never proves pets are accepted, pet fees, pet deposits, weight limits, species restrictions, room restrictions, pet amenities, or current booking availability. Official hotel/brand location pages remain the sole authority for pet policy -- nothing here is a verified listing.
